mechanism: Bank processing, merchant acquiring, payment networks, ecommerce and Clover can convert digital-payment adoption into recurring processing revenue and cash flow when client retention, product growth, service quality and execution are sound; crypto exposure is not required.

Higher funded defense budgets and stockpile replenishment can become missile, air-defense, naval, sensor, and engine awards that RTX converts through qualified production, deliveries, and sustainment into revenue, segment profit, cash flow, and backlog; shareholder transmission depends on pricing, productivity, mix, fixed-price execution, suppliers, export approvals, commercial aerospace, Pratt remediation, leverage, and valuation.

Mercado Pago converts adoption of digital payments and financial accounts into acquiring fees, financial income and commerce engagement. Q2 2026 fintech monthly active users reached 88 million, TPV reached USD 101 billion, AUM reached USD 23 billion and the credit portfolio exceeded USD 16 billion. The mechanism is positive but conditional: rapid credit expansion, negative credit-card NIMAL, funding requirements and regulation can offset the benefit. Crypto adoption is not required for this relationship.

Geopolitical intrusion, cloud and identity complexity, and regulatory accountability raise continuity and compliance demand; CrowdStrike converts that demand through Falcon subscriptions, Falcon Flex and multi-module adoption into ARR, revenue and cash flow. Fiscal Q2 2027 accelerated net-new ARR and increased module adoption, but pricing quality, retention, platform bundling, incident trust, acquisition spending, stock-based compensation, dilution and valuation constrain per-share realization.

Anduril can buy Palantir Warp Speed software and participate with Palantir in defence programs such as TITAN, so growth in Anduril's product-company model could create software demand or program pull-through for Palantir; however, no current source quantifies Anduril-derived Palantir revenue, margin, contract duration, concentration, or incremental cash flow, and Anduril's separate Army procurement ceiling is neither obligated nor Palantir revenue.

AWS supplies compute, model services and infrastructure to AI workloads; durable utilization and pricing can expand Amazon operating earnings, advertising and retail productivity when incremental returns exceed depreciation, financing, energy and dilution costs.

Government and commercial demand for launches, spacecraft, components, and mission systems can flow directly into Rocket Lab's Launch Services and Space Systems revenue and backlog; shareholder benefit depends on reliable missions, profitable contract conversion, lower cash use, and disciplined financing.

Adoption and utilization of Intuitive's robotically assisted procedure systems expand the installed base and directly drive procedure-linked instruments, accessories, and service revenue; shareholder benefit depends on recurring-revenue growth converting through operating margin, safety, training quality, hospital economics, and cash.

Structural copper scarcity can improve Rio Tinto's realized copper economics and returns from Oyu Tolgoi and other copper assets. The mechanism is currently supported by H1 copper EBITDA of USD 5.7 billion and Q3 Oyu Tolgoi production growth of 27% year over year amid constrained mine supply. Transmission to per-share value remains diluted by iron ore, aluminium, lithium, non-controlling interests, project capital, taxes and leverage; consolidated copper production was only 1% higher year to date through Q3 despite Oyu Tolgoi's ramp.

Meta deploys AI compute and networking to improve recommendations, engagement, advertising returns, content tools and messaging monetization; shareholder value appears only when incremental revenue and margins exceed infrastructure, talent, financing, stock-compensation and Reality Labs costs.

Nearshoring and friendshoring can increase demand for locally compliant flat steel; Ternium's Pesquería downstream lines and DRI-EAF shop can convert that demand into Mexican shipments, utilization, revenue, margins, and ADS-holder earnings, subject to commissioning, customer qualification, trade rules, steel pricing, cash conversion, and non-Mexican exposures.

EV and stationary-storage demand plus constrained supply can support lithium-concentrate prices and volumes, increasing Sigma Lithium's revenue, mine utilization, margins, cash generation, and expansion option value; shareholder benefit depends on production stability, receivable collection, liquidity, debt and offtake obligations, controls, environmental status, Phase 2 funding, and commodity cyclicality.

Sovereign procurement preferences can redirect demand toward qualified European and allied small-UAS suppliers; Parrot can convert that demand through ANAFI UKR production and institutional sales into revenue, gross profit, and cash flow, subject to award value, customer concentration, component provenance, supply constraints, operating costs, working capital, and dilution-aware valuation.

Lithium demand and tighter supply can raise Albemarle's realized Energy Storage prices, volumes, margins, operating cash flow, and resource option value; shareholder benefit depends on contract lags, costs, inventory timing, capex, taxes, leverage, supply response, and dilution.

Higher-density computing and broader electrification require power distribution, power quality, switchgear, thermal-management and related infrastructure. Eaton's Q2 2026 Electrical Americas and Electrical Global organic growth, orders, backlog and 1.2 electrical book-to-bill ratio show this demand reaching reported operations, although project delays, cancellations, customer concentration, acquisition integration and elevated leverage can weaken the transmission into per-share value.

Higher-density data centers and broader electrification require medium-voltage switchgear, packaged electrical rooms, controls and protection between grid or on-site generation and loads; Powell can convert that demand into orders, backlog, revenue, margin and cash, subject to project and customer concentration, cancellations, fixed-price execution, capacity, working capital and valuation.

EV and stationary-storage demand plus constrained supply can raise SQM's realized lithium prices, volumes, gross profit, earnings, cash generation, and resource option value; ADS-holder benefit depends on Chilean partnership attribution and state take, contract pricing, permits, conversion ramp, capex, minority interests, debt, and commodity cyclicality.

Structural copper scarcity can raise Southern Copper's realized copper revenue, mine margins, operating cash flow, reserve value, and returns on funded growth; shareholder transmission depends on production, grades, recoveries, by-product credits, costs, taxes, project spending, jurisdictional terms, and capital allocation.

Recursion applies computational models, biological data, and automated experimentation to identify and advance drug candidates; repeatable gains in target selection, cycle time, or clinical translation can create pipeline and partner value, but common-share benefit depends on trial success, partner economics, operating burn, capital needs, and dilution.

Recurring grocery demand, local-brand scale, own-brand penetration and omnichannel density can stabilize Ahold Delhaize sales and cash generation through consumer pressure. That resilience can reach shareholders when value investment preserves traffic and volume while operating margin, capital expenditure, leases and payout commitments remain covered by internally generated cash.

Durable EV and stationary-storage lithium demand plus delayed supply can improve expected lithium pricing, Thacker Pass operating economics, construction funding, offtake value, and the project option value attributable to Lithium Americas common shares; transmission depends on 62% ownership, remaining capex, DOE and GM terms, warrants, dilution, schedule, commissioning, and product qualification.

Growth in industrial robotics and embodied AI can increase demand for robot controllers, drives, motors, machine automation, engineering software, and lifecycle service that ABB historically could convert into revenue, margin, and cash flow; however, ABB has agreed to divest Robotics, expects the net proceeds in the second half of 2026, and does not disclose material recurring RobotStudio or humanoid-attributable economics, so the common shares do not provide a durable direct transmission channel for this idea.

AI training and inference demand converts directly into NVIDIA accelerator, networking, interconnect, system and software revenue; platform breadth and rapid product cadence can retain economics as clusters scale, while hyperscaler capex concentration, export controls, custom silicon, supply commitments and valuation constrain shareholder returns.

AI-native drug discovery can create demand for NVIDIA accelerated compute, software, data infrastructure and automated-lab integration, and the Lilly co-innovation lab establishes a concrete channel; however, the disclosed sector commitment is not NVIDIA revenue and is immaterial relative to NVIDIA's diversified Data Center economics without broader repeat adoption.

Nomad's established frozen-food brands, positive price/mix and supply-chain productivity can transmit recurring grocery demand into margin and cash-flow resilience. Q2 adjusted gross margin rose 110 basis points and management continued to expect at least 90% adjusted free-cash-flow conversion. The mechanism remains conditional rather than proven because Q2 volume fell 5.9%, first-half adjusted EBITDA fell 13.3%, and refinancing-related interest expense caused an adjusted-EPS guidance reduction.

Asset-light franchise fees, supply-chain economics and unit growth can convert recurring pizza demand into operating cash flow and shareholder returns if franchisee economics, comparable sales, debt service and reinvestment remain healthy.

AI models trained on Recursion's biological and chemical data, coupled with automated wet-lab experiments, can shorten candidate-selection loops and generate proprietary drug programs; Recursion can capture value through owned-pipeline economics and partner milestones only if candidates survive clinical and regulatory validation and the resulting value exceeds operating burn, data commitments, financing, and dilution.

Rising data-centre electricity demand and grid constraints increase demand for generation equipment, services, and electrification systems; GE Vernova can convert that demand through Power and Electrification into orders, backlog, revenue, margins, and cash flow, subject to project schedules, customer concentration, backlog quality, working-capital normalization, Wind execution, capacity investment, acquisition integration, and valuation.

Uber can monetize demand aggregation, dispatch, payments, safety, advertising and utilization across human-driven and autonomous supply if riders and fleet partners value marketplace distribution more than vertical integration.

Creator content and discovery can increase Roblox users, hours, payer activity, bookings, revenue, and cash flow; shareholder benefit depends on safety and trust, creator and infrastructure costs, cohort durability, cash conversion, and dilution discipline.

Structural copper scarcity can raise Freeport-McMoRan's realized copper prices, mine margins, operating cash flow, and reserve option value; shareholder benefit depends on attributable production, unit costs, capital spending, minority interests, safety, and Indonesian operating terms.

Prosus has concentrated economic exposure to Tencent's gaming, social-attention and consumer-services ecosystem and owns operating platforms in food delivery, classifieds, travel and payments. Growth and cash generation can increase look-through NAV, while repurchases below NAV can raise each remaining ordinary N share's exposure. The transmission is indirect and can be weakened by Tencent declines, private-asset write-downs, central debt, acquisitions, governance or a persistent holding-company discount.

Scaling AI training and inference requires low-latency, high-throughput network fabrics. Arista can monetize that infrastructure expansion through Ethernet switching and routing platforms, including its disclosed 1.6 Tbps AI-fabric products, plus EOS software and related services. Conversion into durable per-share earnings remains contingent on customer deployment timing, Ethernet architecture adoption, competition, qualification, supply execution, product mix, and customer concentration.

Clearer rules and broader adoption can increase regulated trading, custody, stablecoin balances, payments, financing, and on-chain activity; Coinbase can monetize those flows through transaction fees, stablecoin revenue, subscriptions and services, institutional products, custody, and Base, subject to crypto-cycle, rate, partner-term, take-rate, counterparty, custody, cyber, regulatory, stock-compensation, dilution, and valuation risks.

Tencent can convert games, Weixin attention, advertising, payments and cloud engagement into revenue, margins and cash flow, with AI improving discovery and monetization when incremental compute returns exceed capital and operating costs.

Growth in industrial robotics and embodied AI can increase demand for NVIDIA simulation, world models, training compute, edge modules, safety tooling and the CUDA developer stack; integrations across major robot makers and humanoid developers establish a product channel, although attributable revenue and deployment economics remain undisclosed.

Electric-load growth, data-centre construction, utility capital expenditure, and grid constraints increase demand for Atkore electrical raceway, conduit, and cable-management products; shareholder benefit depends on pricing catching input costs and volume converting to free cash flow.

A recovery in residential solar financing, installer health, channel inventory, and storage adoption directly raises demand for Enphase microinverters, batteries, gateways, and energy-management software; shareholder benefit depends on margin, cash, warranty, tariff, and policy quality.

Load growth, renewable penetration, grid congestion, and reliability needs increase demand for Fluence storage systems, services, and optimization software; shareholder benefit depends on project margin, working-capital, warranty, and financing conversion.

A Terafab ramp into advanced logic and memory requires production lithography systems, software, upgrades and field service that ASML can monetize; xLight's government-funded free-electron-laser work is a prototype source option rather than a qualified scanner replacement, while Terafab-specific tool orders and timing remain undisclosed.

Intel could monetize process integration, fabrication and advanced-packaging expertise through Terafab and could gain utilization, services or IP economics, but the only current Terafab evidence describes Intel's contribution as proposed and discloses no definitive agreement, work scope, process node, fees, capacity, IP terms, milestones, revenue or cash flow.

Terafab and SpaceXAI require immediately deployable general-purpose training, inference, networking and software while internal fabrication is built and qualified; NVIDIA can convert that demand through Vera Rubin systems, Space-1 orbital modules, interconnect, networking and CUDA into revenue and cash flow, while any domestic packaging or selected-silicon benefit remains conditional and unannounced.

Terafab and SpaceXAI require HBM, server memory, foundry and packaging capacity while internal memory and logic are unqualified; Samsung can monetize the transition through its Nvidia-aligned HBM and integrated semiconductor capabilities, but no Terafab-specific contract or volume is disclosed and successful insourcing creates long-run displacement risk.

SpaceX is the proposed owner, principal user and systems integrator of Terafab; successful internal packaging, selected silicon and compute-system production could reduce deployment bottlenecks and improve iteration speed for Starlink, Starship, xAI and orbital compute, but those benefits accrue only if utilization, yield and cost exceed the campus's capital and governance burden.

Tesla designs workload-specific inference chips for vehicles, robotics and AI systems; a qualified Terafab process and packaging route could shorten design-to-production cycles, improve supply security and coordinate edge-compute products with SpaceXAI demand, but the public framework is non-binding and discloses no capacity, price, capital or ownership economics.

SpaceXAI and Terafab's staged buildout increase near-term demand for externally fabricated Nvidia and custom silicon while internal logic, packaging and memory are unqualified; TSMC can monetize that bridge through leading-node wafers and advanced packaging, but successful Terafab internalization creates a long-run displacement risk.

NVIDIA's 800 VDC AI-factory architecture can accelerate SiC and GaN adoption and can reduce current, copper, conversion stages and power-delivery constraints around NVIDIA systems, but NVIDIA is the architecture and compute vendor rather than the evidenced WBG component supplier and discloses no material WBG-attributable revenue or margin.
